constraints.ocl:
context BOMItem
inv: (self.inventoryItem <> null) and (self.requiredQty mod 3 = 0)

context WorkOrder
inv: (self.plannedQuantity < 50) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed = true))

context WorkOrder
inv: (self.plannedQuantity > 2) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed = true))

context Supplier
inv: self.shipments->exists(x | x.received <> true)

context Product
inv: self.unitPrice >= 19 and self.unitPrice <= 93

context BillOfMaterials
inv: (self.items->any(x | x.requiredQty > 1) <> null) and (self.bomId.indexOf('test') >= 0)

context ProductionLine
inv: self.workOrders->any(x | x.plannedQuantity >= 1) <> null

context Shift
inv: self.startTime <> null and self.endTime <> null

context Shift
inv: self.endTime <> null implies self.startTime <> null

context BOMItem
inv: (self.name <> null) and (self.requiredQty mod 2 = 0)

context Shift
inv: self.startTime <> null implies self.endTime <> null

context DefectReport
inv: (self.qualityCheck <> null) and (self.defectId <> null)

context WorkOrder
inv: (self.plannedQuantity > 5) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed = true))
